# VOORMI

> > Technical wool apparel engineered for mountain performance, featuring DUAL SURFACE moisture management and Phase.Sc concealment technology.

VOORMI is a Colorado-based outdoor apparel company specializing in advanced merino wool garments for hunting, skiing, and mountain lifestyles. Their proprietary technologies include DUAL SURFACE moisture-wicking, Core Construction waterproofing, and Phase.Sc spatial pattern concealment, with manufacturing rooted in Pagosa Springs.

## Key Topics

- DUAL SURFACE moisture management
- Phase.Sc concealment technology
- Core Construction waterproofing
- Merino wool technical apparel
- Pagosa Springs, Colorado
- San Juan Mountains
- Backcountry skiing gear
- Hunting concealment apparel
- Moisture-wicking technology
- Odor-resistant fabrics
- Avalanche safety (CAIC)
- Technical outerwear
- Mountain lifestyle
- Thermal regulation

## Men's Apparel Collections

- [Men's](https://voormi.com/collections/mens): Men's technical outdoor apparel from base layers to insulated outerwear
- [Men's Jackets and Vests](https://voormi.com/collections/mens-jackets-and-vests): Men's outerwear collection featuring weather-resistant jackets and vests
- [1/4 Zip Mock Neck](https://voormi.com/products/1-4-zip-mock-neck): Quarter-zip mock neck base layer with DUAL SURFACE and Phase.SC camo tech

## Women's Apparel Collections

- [Women's](https://voormi.com/collections/womens): Women's technical wool apparel collection from ultralight tees to jackets
- [Women's VOORMI Puffy](https://voormi.com/products/womens-voormi-puffy): Women's down jacket with merino wool liner and DUAL SURFACE moisture tech

## Specialized Collections

- [Phase.Sc™ Concealment Collection](https://voormi.com/collections/hunting-collection): Phase.Sc concealment hunting apparel with odor resistance and thermal control
- [New Arrivals](https://voormi.com/collections/new-arrivals): Latest technical wool apparel releases with advanced moisture management
- [Roadtrip Essentials](https://voormi.com/collections/roadtrip-essentials): Travel apparel collection with moisture-wicking, anti-odor technology
